每次作答后，按上次复习到现在实际隔了几天、这次答得怎样，估算这道题还能记多久，在: After each answer, the scheduler estimates how long you will remember the question from the days that really passed since its last review and how well you answered, and sets the next review for when your predicted recall drops to the target. A wrong answer shortens the gap, though not always back to 1 day.
下次复习时，希望还有多大把握记得这道题。调高：复习更勤，记得更牢；调低：复习更少: How likely you want to still remember a question when it comes back. Higher: more frequent reviews and firmer memory. Lower: fewer reviews and more forgetting. Default 90%, from 70% to 97%.
两次复习之间最多隔几天。离考试不远时，可以设成离考试天数的一半，保证考前每道题至: The most days between two reviews. With an exam not far off, set it to about half the days left, so every question comes back at least once before the exam. Default 36500 days, which means no limit.
默认值就能用；只有想复习得更勤或更少时才需要改。: The defaults work as they are. Change them only if you want reviews more or less often.
